talk.transcript: Today, we’re going to discuss the concept of biodiversity. Biodiversity refers to the variety of life found on Earth, including the different species of plants, animals, and microorganisms. It also encompasses the genetic diversity within these species and the ecosystems they form. Biodiversity is crucial for ecosystem stability. When biodiversity is high, ecosystems can better withstand changes and recover from disturbances. Conversely, a loss of biodiversity can lead to ecosystem degradation, affecting food security and human health. Protecting biodiversity is vital for maintaining the health of our planet for future generations.
